en:
<CLT=cltMIND>Before I left the academy...
I decided to talk alone with Himiko.

<CLT=cltMIND>This is the last day we'll spend
at this academy...

<CLT=cltMIND>This school life was crazy, but now that
I think back on it, we had some good times.

Of course I wanna leave, but...it makes 
me sad to think our days here are over.

Yeah. Nothing really eventful happened,
but I had a lot of fun with everyone.

Everyone here was nice...if I forget 
that they called my magic "tricks."

Hrmmm...but now that I 
remember it, it annoys me...

How rude of them...
Calling my magic "tricks"...

Once we're outta here, I need to have 
them watch my show to set them straight.
When we're out of here...

Ah, that's right, you were going to
keep up your tricks after we got out.
Not "magic tricks"! It's real magic!
Ah, sorry...

Geez...I can't be off guard 
for even a second.
Well, anyway...

Of course I'm gonna keep practicing 
my magic once I get outta here.

So I can be onstage with 
my master once again.
Th-That's right...

"That's right"? You didn't forget 
about it till now, did you?
N-No, not at all...

Then, tell me what my master 
is doing right now, magically...
<CLT=cltMIND>Himiko's master is...
Enjoying a quiet retirement
A dark mage
Training to perform with Himiko again
He's enjoying a quiet retirement...

Th-That's...
It's not impossible...
No! It is impossible!

My master put more passion into 
his magic than any other mage!
He'd never retire quietly!

<CLT=cltMIND>That was wrong.
Himiko's master is...
He has become a dark mage...
Hrmmm...

Can you really say such a messed up 
thing right at the end here?
Maybe *you're* a dark mage!

<CLT=cltMIND>That was wrong.
Himiko's master is...

He's perfecting his tricks, training
to perform with you again, Himiko.
Wrong.
Wrong? But...

It's a magic show cuz we do 
magic in it! Not tricks!
Ah, sorry!
Geez, until the very end...
But besides that part, you got it right.

My master must be doing magic 
training at this very moment.

That's why I need to polish 
my own skills.

If you and your master ever put on
a show, I'll make sure to go see it.

Of course... After all, you're the only
one who understands my magic.

If you don't come see our 
new show, I won't forgive you.

I'm gonna force you to watch from 
a special seat, no matter what.

<CLT=cltMIND>I wonder when they'll
get to perform again?

<CLT=cltMIND>I can picture it. I imagine Himiko
having so much fun...
<CLT=cltMIND>She's smiling, crying tears of joy...

<CLT=cltMIND>And I wish from the bottom of my heart that
that day comes sooner rather than later.

<CLT=cltMIND>My wish... Her wish...
will definitely come true.

<CLT=cltMIND>I will do everything I can to
see that wish granted.

<CLT=cltMIND>And thus, our days at the
Ultimate Academy for Gifted Juveniles...
<CLT=cltMIND>came to an end.

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>You've acquired a new theme,
"Love Across the Universe."
